prompt:
Use the attached invidious.png image as a style reference only: match its simple friendly rounded 2D cartoon, thick rounded dark-brown outlines, flat colors, and minimal soft shading. Do not copy its subjects or composition. Subject: submarine in the sense of undersea ship.

Composition: A rounded gray submarine travels just beneath a small blue water surface, with its conning tower, short periscope, rear propeller, and portholes visible. Show the complete vessel in profile with only a few bubbles and no weapons.

Style: Match only the rounded 2D style of references/invidious.png: thick dark-brown outlines, simple readable shapes, restrained cartoon shading, and friendly faces when people appear.

Framing: One coherent scene, centered, with the complete subject occupying about 80–90% of the square. Keep all essential body parts and object tips fully inside the frame without clipping.

Output: One 512 x 512 PNG with true RGBA transparency in the background and gaps. No lettering, labels, logo, watermark, or checkerboard.
en: A complete gray submarine travels beneath the water surface, with a periscope, portholes, propeller, and bubbles.
ja: 水面下を進む潜水艦。潜望鏡や丸窓、スクリュー、気泡が見える。
